camel_example: aliyun cas Encrypt --region cn-hangzhou --Plaintext 1234000 --CertIdentifier '1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265' --WarehouseId 12 --CustomIdentifier 00006bb538d538c70c01f81dg30000 --Algorithm RSAESOAEPSHA_1 --MessageType RAW
description_en: Encrypts data by using a certificate in a certificate application repository
description_zh: 本接口一般用于证书仓库中证书加密
kebab_example: aliyun cas encrypt --plaintext 1234000 --cert-identifier 1ef1da5f-38ed-69b3-0000-037781890265 --algorithm RSAESOAEPSHA_1 --message-type RAW --custom-identifier 00006bb538d538c70c01f81dg30000 --warehouse-id 12 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Encrypt

parameters.help_en:
The data to encrypt. The data can be plaintext or Base64-encoded plaintext. For more information, see the MessageType parameter. If you use Base64 encoding, for example, if the hexadecimal content of the data to be encrypted is `[0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34]`, the corresponding Base64-encoded string is MTIzNA==. The maximum size of Plaintext depends on the Algorithm:

- **RSAES\_OAEP\_SHA\_1**: 214 bytes.

- **RSAES\_OAEP\_SHA\_256**: 190 bytes.

- **SM2PKE**: 6047 bytes
parameters.help_zh:
待加密数据。
可以是原文，也可以对原文进行Base64。具体参考MessageType字段。
如果使用Base64编码，例如：待加密数据的十六进制内容为`[0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34]`，则对应的Base64编码为MTIzNA==。
Plaintext数据大小限制根据Algorithm的取值有所不同，具体如下：

- **RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1**：214字节。
- **RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256**：190字节。
- **SM2PKE**：6047字节
parameters.name: plaintext

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the certificate. To obtain this parameter, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455806.html operation.

- The identifier of an SSL certificate is usually in the {Certificate ID}-cn-hangzhou format.

- For a private certificate authority (PCA) certificate, this is the value of the Identifier field of the private certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书唯一识别码。该参数可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455806.html获取。
- SSL证书识别码一般为{证书ID}-cn-hangzhou。
- PCA证书为对应私有证书的Identifier字段
parameters.name: cert_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:

- RAW (default): Directly encrypts the value of Plaintext.

- Base64: Decodes the Base64-encoded value of Plaintext and then encrypts the decoded data
parameters.help_zh:
消息类型。取值：

- RAW（默认值）：将会对Plaintext直接加密操作。
- Base64：Plaintext为base64编码格式，将会对Plaintext base64解密之后再进行加密操作
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.help_en: The custom identifier, which serves as a unique key
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义标识，唯一键
parameters.name: custom_identifier

parameters.help_en:
The repository ID.

> To obtain this ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
仓库ID。
> 此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455805.html获取
parameters.name: warehouse_id
